actions.action: Enforce expiry at the display boundary
actions.mechanism: Suppress timestamped items when local time plus 30 seconds reaches expiry, independently of connectivity.
actions.implementation: Check eligibility before rendering and clear visible items at that threshold. Keep explicit-until-revoked items eligible unless removed.
actions.check: Simulate six-hour outages with clock offsets of ±30 seconds; verify no timestamped item remains visible past its actual expiry.
actions.risk: Conservative suppression can hide announcements up to 60 seconds early.

actions.action: Reject stale configurations without accumulating removal records
actions.mechanism: Complete snapshots make absence authoritative; persistent generation ordering prevents older bundles from restoring removed revisions.
actions.implementation: Assign increasing generations; reject stale item mutations server-side. Devices accept only newer complete snapshots. Reject publication when serialized size reaches 100 KB.
actions.check: Remove an item, apply that snapshot, reboot, then replay earlier snapshots; verify absence persists. Verify oversized publication fails.
actions.risk: Complete snapshots impose a hard capacity limit on active announcements.

actions.action: Stage reconnect updates before switching the display
actions.mechanism: Isolated staging and atomic activation prevent interrupted transfers from mixing old and new configuration states.
actions.implementation: Expose downloading, validating, and active states. Validate completeness, IDs, revisions, flags, and size; atomically commit snapshot and generation. Continue expiry enforcement throughout.
actions.check: Interrupt transfers and power at every transition; recovery must select one complete snapshot with its matching generation.
actions.risk: Validation failure leaves cached content active; offline revocations remain unknown.

actions.action: Show freshness limits alongside offline announcements
actions.mechanism: A persistent status distinguishes locally enforced expiry from removal information that requires a successful connection.
actions.implementation: Show last successful synchronization time and: “Offline: expired announcements are hidden. Until-revoked announcements may remain after removal; emergency removals cannot be guaranteed.”
actions.check: Disconnect for six hours; verify the warning remains visible, including when no announcements remain, and clears only after successful synchronization.
actions.risk: Status text requires readable placement and must not obscure announcements.
